name: capi2-campaign-action-notary
short_description: Block unauthorized ad publications, bid changes and budget increases before an AI agent executes them.
detailed_description: An independent pre-action guardrail for TikTok advertising agents. It checks advertiser authority, campaign action allow-lists, currency and spending ceilings, hashed approval evidence, prohibited claim terms and public destination support. It returns allow, manual_review or block and can issue a tamper-evident decision receipt without executing the campaign mutation.
showcase_prompts: Can this agent raise campaign cmp_456 to EUR 5,000 per day under the current advertiser authority?
Check this ad claim against its landing page before I publish it.
Create a verifiable approval receipt before this agent changes a TikTok campaign bid.
disclaimer: Independent service; not affiliated with, endorsed by or approved by TikTok. Decision support only; it does not execute campaign actions.
